_comment: The 6-sprite picker grid: drives the REAL character-creation UI path. starts_at_title gives raw title control; creation_ui:true makes New Game open the creation screen (the default TestDriver skip goes straight to Game.reset with defaults, so every OTHER canonical is byte-unchanged). PC_OPTIONS is laid out row-major (row0 = Male across Human/Drake/Gnoll, row1 = Female) so cursor 0 starts on Human/Male; one move_right then one move_down lands on Drake/Female (same pick this canonical made pre-#42). Confirming the card sets pc_race+pc_gender TOGETHER (the payload keys the sim asserts below are byte-identical to before -- presentation-only recomposition). Asserts the snapshot identity fields, the sim variant sprite key, the GDI opener event (de-race-ified 2026-07-07 -- one opener for all races; `race` stays in the payload harmlessly, cosmetic only now), and the RENDERED variant binding on both the field (ui_entities_rendered pc_sprite) and combat is proven by the sim key (combat chip resolves the same pc_drake_f via board_renderer). Mouse teeth: after the keyboard confirm lands on NAME, an Esc-back + click-the-same-card round trip re-confirms drake_f via a mouse click, pinning the identical step:'name' payload the keyboard path just produced; the NAME step then commits via the tappable Begin control (click_char_creation_begin, issue #106) with every downstream pin held verbatim from the keyboard-commit era -- click/keyboard commit equivalence proven by the pins themselves.

steps._comment: Cursor 0(human_m) -> col 1(drake) in the top (male) row.

2026-07-08 hotfix wave item 6: the picker grid itself had no canonical visual coverage before this (only the post-creation inn did) -- windowed-only no-op under headless (test_driver.gd's _screenshot early-returns for DisplayServer 'headless'), same established precedent as every other screenshot step in this suite.
steps.name: 00_picker_grid_drake_f_selected

steps._comment: Mouse-click round trip: Esc backs up to PICK, re-highlighting the same card just confirmed (_option_index() resolves drake/f back to cursor 4); a click on that SAME card (card_rect(4), 1-based 'card':5) re-confirms it, pinning the IDENTICAL step:'name' payload the keyboard confirm above just produced -- click-confirm dispatch parity for the exact selection a real player would have made, not a parallel activation path.
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: Issue #106: the name commit goes through the tappable Begin control (click_char_creation_begin resolves the LIVE begin_button_rect, the click_char_creation_card idiom) instead of the keyboard confirm -- the button's gui_input calls the SAME _confirm() Enter's _handle_name_input branch does, and every downstream pin below (the ui_char_creation_confirmed payload, world_ready, the GDI opener, the sim identity asserts, the rendered variant binding) is held VERBATIM from the keyboard-commit era of this script, so the click path proving them is the equivalence proof. Only one commit is possible per run (Game.reset tears this screen down), so the keyboard NAME-commit dispatch itself is covered by this screen's PICK-step confirm above (same _unhandled_input -> _confirm() route) + char_creation_peek's keyboard commit.

GDI opener (2026-07-07 rewrite: one race-neutral system-readout opener, no more Drake/Human/Gnoll branch) -- lines still 4; race stays in the payload cosmetically (Game.sim.pc_race is unchanged, so this pin still holds).
Sim identity fields in the snapshot (art-independent).
The sim's variant key (presentation resolves this to the pc_drake_f sprite at both bind sites).
The RENDERED field binding: world.gd resolved the PC visual to the drake/f variant art.
